# CANDIDATE: EARLY_MORNING_GAP_FADE_RSI

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Large opening gaps often exhaust momentum; extreme RSI readings at the gap increase the probability of a fade. The edge exists because gap-driven moves frequently reverse after initial exhaustion, especially when momentum oscillators show overextension.

## Mechanism

At 09:30‑09:35 ET, if the opening gap (open‑previous close) >+0.5% and the 5‑min RSI(14) ≥70, enter short at the close of that 5‑min bar; if the gap <‑0.5% and RSI ≤30, enter long at the close. Require volume ≥1.3× the average 5‑min volume of the first 15 minutes. Exit: chart‑stop at the opposite side of the gap (short stop above gap high, long stop below gap low), initial target 1.5R, then trail with a chandelier at 2×ATR. Regime filter: only trade when VIX <25 and opening‑range width <0.8% of SPY; only consider first 20 minutes after open.
